## ea3fc2d64936

**Reproduced defect — the generated domain excludes most public morphology and
makes a forced-origin shortcut perfect.** Generator SHA256
`ecb7a8803d80643969e3236570a0bd6b89a5292e7737ecbee45c9e96468244a6`;
canonical rule normalized hash `ac9febe76e9c` (the generator declares no
`RULE_HASH`).

The generator requires every normalized component mask to contain `(0,0)` and
its `self_check` rejects any component that does not. Three of the five canonical
public inputs contain an origin-empty normalized component, so 3/5 public pairs
fail the target validator. In a final-source sample of 450 generated inputs
(seeds 0–49, sample indices 0–2, easy/medium/hard), all 450 masks occupied the
normalized origin and a rival that forcibly inserts `(0,0)` into every component
matched all 450 outputs. Counts, exact sample specification, and source hash are
in `checks/audit-prevalence.json`.

The retained Racket counterexample is canonical training pair 0 in
`checks/audit-ea3-origin-counterexample.json`. The canonical Racket output has
value 3 at output `(0,0)` because only two of three masks occupy that location;
the generated-domain rival outputs 4 by assuming all three do. The actual Racket
output matches the stored public answer. This input is canonical but does **not**
pass the target validator and is outside the generator's documented domain—the
mismatch itself is the finding.

The same source also has an unpinned rule and dead controls: warm/cool
`palette_kind`, `palette_size` 3/8, `n_distinct_colors` 3/8, and warm/cool
`texture` produced identical inputs in the retained probe; an unknown override
was accepted unchanged. Framework lint and defect-lint failures are in
`checks/audit-ea3-lint/` and `checks/audit-ea3-defect/`. No fix was made because
this was an audit-only target.

triage.reason: Both source-bound audit reports retained. Target census counts remain reviewer-reported, not an independently rerun target battery. Targets left untouched.

## ea3fc2d64936

**Classification: reproduced defects; target left unchanged.** Audited generator SHA-256 `ecb7a8803d80643969e3236570a0bd6b89a5292e7737ecbee45c9e96468244a6`.

The lint stage reproduces a missing `RULE_HASH`; the tool reports current canonical rule hash `ac9febe76e9c`. It also reports singleton, unprobed `position_bias` and `density` axes. Evidence: `checks/audit/ea3fc2d64936-lint-v2/checks/ea3fc2d64936_before_lint.log`.

Defect lint reproduces an ordinary texture domain that includes the negative fixtures `all_same_shape`, `no_components`, and `single_component`. The helpful textures `default`, `warm`, `cool`, and `varied` are byte-identical to untextured draws over the sampled seeds, so those controls are dead. Evidence: `checks/audit/ea3fc2d64936-defect_lint-v2/checks/ea3fc2d64936_before_defect_lint.log`.

The override contract fails across `88,830` draws with `16,955` findings and `41,040` undeclared multi-axis rejections. A minimized example requests `grid_h=10` with `texture=all_same_shape` and observes height `9`; analogous width mismatches and invalid negative-texture scenes recur. The unknown key `__override_contract_unknown_axis__` is accepted rather than rejected. Evidence: `checks/audit/ea3fc2d64936-override-v2/checks/ea3fc2d64936_before_override_results.json` and its log.

These are executable contract defects, not a speculative semantic shortcut. I did not edit the audit target or its authority.

audits.resolution_reason: Confirmed prior forced-origin overlay defect: validator rejects 3/5 canonical inputs, generated masks always occupy normalized origin in 450 draws. Canonical authoritative counterexample retained; target unchanged.

## ea3fc2d64936

**Confirmed unresolved distribution/validator defect; target left unchanged.**
Generator SHA-256
`ecb7a8803d80643969e3236570a0bd6b89a5292e7737ecbee45c9e96468244a6`;
selected Racket hash `ac9febe76e9c`. I used the existing review index as a lead
and independently reran a source-bound reproduction.

The generator forces every normalized component mask to occupy `(0,0)`, and its
validator rejects lawful masks that do not. Fresh evidence checks all five
labeled canonical pairs: 3/5 are rejected. Across 450 generated inputs (easy,
medium, hard; seeds 0..49; sample indices 0..2), 450/450 have every normalized
mask occupy the origin. Thus a forced-origin overlay rival is perfect on the
sampled generated domain.

The retained counterexample is canonical train pair 0. The target validator
rejects it because color 4 normalizes without `(0,0)`. The selected Racket
output is `[[3,3,0],[3,4,3]]`; the forced-origin rival differs at one cell.
`checks/audit/ea3fc2d64936/racket.json` records the actual authority output,
rule/generator hashes, and input/output hashes. Reproducer and aggregate details:
`checks/audit/ea3fc2d64936/reproduce.py` and `summary.json`. This input is
canonical and rule-lawful but outside the generator's declared validator domain;
that mismatch is the finding.
